categories.main_business_segments: Cabio Biotech primarily operates in human nutrition, animal nutrition, and beauty & personal care sectors. Its main products include polyunsaturated fatty acids such as ARA and DHA, sialic acid (SA), natural beta-carotene, and human milk oligosaccharides (HMOs). The company also extends into functional cosmetic ingredients and animal feed additives, focusing on innovative bio-based nutritional solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages synthetic biology as its foundational technology, employing microbial fermentation and cell factory methods for production. Key technologies include plasma mutagenesis for strain selection, precise fermentation control, high-efficiency separation and purification, microencapsulation, and multi-omics for product efficacy research. It integrates AI and automation in its R&D and manufacturing processes to enhance strain development, fermentation optimization, and product innovation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Cabio serves major infant formula manufacturers, health food companies, pet nutrition brands, and cosmetic ingredient clients. Its key customers include global and domestic leaders such as Nestlé, Danone, Cargill, Feihe, Yili, Junlebao, and Synutra. The products are widely used in infant formula, dietary supplements, pet food, and personal care products, targeting both domestic and international markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases in Wuhan and other locations, and its products are sold across over 30 countries and regions including Europe, North America, Australia, New Zealand, and Southeast Asia. It has established subsidiaries and joint ventures in Hong Kong, Thailand, Australia, and other regions to support its global supply chain and market expansion.
categories.supply_chain_position: Cabio operates primarily in the upstream and midstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on the research, development, and manufacturing of bio-based nutritional ingredients. It supplies these high-value raw materials to downstream infant formula producers, health product manufacturers, pet food companies, and cosmetic brands, acting as a key ingredient supplier and technology partner.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes advancing synthetic biology platforms integrated with AI and multi-omics technologies to accelerate strain development and product innovation. Strategic R&D priorities include expanding HMOs product lines, optimizing fermentation and purification processes, developing new functional lipids and bioactive molecules, and deepening applications in human nutrition, animal nutrition, and beauty care. It also focuses on digital transformation, intelligent manufacturing, and international market penetration.
categories.revenue_model: Cabio generates revenue mainly through the sale of bio-based nutritional ingredients and specialty products to B2B customers. Its sales channels include direct sales domestically and a combination of direct and distributor sales internationally. The company also earns income from licensing patents and providing technical services to partners.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Cabio is a leading domestic player and a significant global supplier in the ARA and DHA markets, breaking foreign technology monopolies. It competes with international chemical and biotech giants like BASF, DSM, and DuPont in the bio-based nutrition sector. The company holds a strong market position in China and is expanding its international footprint, leveraging advanced synthetic biology capabilities and strategic partnerships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Cabio reported revenue of approximately RMB 555.6 million, a 25.19% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 124.2 million, up 35.94%. The company maintains steady growth driven by capacity expansion, new product commercialization, and international market development. Its R&D investment accounts for about 8.62% of revenue, reflecting a strong commitment to innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Cabio offers high-quality, bio-based nutritional ingredients produced via advanced synthetic biology and microbial fermentation, ensuring product safety, traceability, and environmental sustainability. Its products, such as ARA, DHA, SA, and HMOs, provide scientifically validated health benefits across life stages and species. The company differentiates itself through proprietary strain development, intelligent manufacturing, comprehensive quality management systems, and strong collaborations with leading global nutrition and health companies.
